title: Switching bound for circuit evaluation
statement: Assume that every Boolean function having a disjunctive or conjunctive normal form of width at most a positive integer $w$ has switching failure probability at rate $1/(10w)$ bounded by $2^{-k}$ for every natural number $k$. Let $T$ be a circuit tail with $m$ inputs, let $g$ be an AND or OR gate, and let each of its input functions have a normal form appropriate to $g$ of width at most $w$. For positive integers $w$ and $\ell$, the switching failure probability of the function computed by $T$ at rate $\frac{1}{10w}\left(\frac{1}{10\ell}\right)^{L-1}$ is at most $N2^{-\ell}+2^{-k}$ for every $k$, where $L$ is the number of layers of $T$ and $N$ is its number of internal gates.
